notes: Factory presets. 'event' is the earthquake id in the pack, 'station' is near / regional / tele. Values use the plugin's own parameter ranges. Unlisted parameters use their defaults.

presets.name: Close Quarters
presets.about: Short, present room for lead vocals. Early arrivals from a station 179 km from the quake give it a body without wash.

presets.name: Ballad Halo
presets.about: Long, smooth halo from a 600 km deep earthquake. Deep slabs ring cleanly; ducking keeps the words clear.

presets.name: Distant Choir
presets.about: Dark, wide tail. The 900 km path has already lost its highs, so it sits behind the voice.

presets.name: Whisper Cave
presets.about: Volcanic rock swallows energy fast: a tight, grainy little space for spoken word and whispers.

presets.name: Tight Kit Room
presets.about: Short volcanic decay with strong early arrivals. Adds a room around a dry kit without smearing hits.

presets.name: Big Snare
presets.about: The Kahramanmaras recording gives a bright, punchy tail for snares and claps.

presets.name: Overheads in the Hall
presets.about: Medium Mediterranean crust: even decay across bands, good on overheads and room mics.

presets.name: Fault Line Break
presets.about: Rough, rhythmic arrivals from a strike-slip fault. Push the grit for breakbeats and loops.

presets.name: Clean Guitar Bloom
presets.about: Intermediate-depth slab, close station: a springy bloom for clean electric guitar.

presets.name: Piano in the Craton
presets.about: Old, cold continental rock barely attenuates: a long, even, clear tail for piano.

presets.name: Rhodes Drift
presets.about: Aegean crust with a slow wobble. Warm and moving under electric piano.

presets.name: Acoustic Body
presets.about: Small and woody. Mostly early arrivals for acoustic guitar and plucked strings.

presets.name: Deep Slab Swell
presets.about: Reversed tail from a 664 km deep earthquake: sound swells into every note.

presets.name: Mantle Drone
presets.about: Ten seconds of a M8.3 deep quake crossing 4000 km. Huge and dark, for drones.

presets.name: Aurora Pad
presets.about: Long, bright and shimmering, from the 2025 M8.8 Kamchatka earthquake.

presets.name: Surface Wave Pluck
presets.about: Only the surface waves: a rolling, pitched tail that suits arpeggios and plucks.

presets.name: Glue Room
presets.about: A barely-there short space to put a mix or bus in one room.

presets.name: Wide Ambience
presets.about: Clear eastern-US craton: airy, wide and neutral for ambience sends.

presets.name: Dialogue Space
presets.about: Natural small-space feel for film and podcast dialogue.

presets.name: Far Field
presets.about: Everything far away: a dark, diffuse wash to push sounds back in the mix.

presets.name: Aftershock
presets.about: The signature: starts at the P wave, raw ground motion and exaggerated decay.

presets.name: Tsunami Siren
presets.about: Reversed teleseismic recording of the 2010 M8.8 Maule earthquake. A long rising sweep.

presets.name: Ground Truth
presets.about: Pure audification: the seismogram itself, played faster, as the reverb.

presets.name: Frozen Fault
presets.about: Freeze is on: play a sound and it hangs in the 2025 Mandalay rupture.

presets.name: Ring of Fire
presets.about: The 2011 M9.1 Tohoku earthquake recorded 3850 km away. Neutral settings: hear the data.

presets.name: Ocean Floor
presets.about: The largest strike-slip earthquake ever recorded, inside the Indian Ocean plate.

presets.name: Outback
presets.about: Central Australia, among the oldest and stillest rock on Earth.

presets.name: Mid-Atlantic
presets.about: A transform fault on the Atlantic ridge, far from any continent.
